messages:
Sam: Need final wording for the public status page and a plan for who gets the full RCA for yesterday's outage. Quick sync.
Priya: I can draft the public blurb. Two-step approach: short public summary tonight, detailed RCA to contract customers after legal review.
Noah: Ops: confirmed window 22:05-22:33 UTC, ~18k retries, ~260 5xx. No auth/data exposure.
Ally: Support should own targeted distribution (they have the contact lists). Engineering authors the RCA, product owns public copy.
legal-bot: Legal: public summary must state whether customer data was exposed. Full RCAs only to customers under contract/NDA; please record approvals in the postmortem.
Sam: Draft status line: "Resolved: intermittent elevated latency and failed requests in us-west (22:05-22:33 UTC). Cause: upstream network instability that impacted cache warm-up. Mitigation: config rollback and cache persistence. No customer data exposed. Full RCA to affected contract customers after review."
Priya: I'll post that to #incidents-drafts for quick review. Add a sentence about scheduling a reliability review to address recurring flaps.
Noah: I'll add a monitoring rule to count similar flaps over 14d and open an infra follow-up ticket.
Ally: Action items:
- Noah: paste final timeline + counts into postmortem (by 12:00 PT)
- Priya: publish public status + customer email draft (by 18:00 PT)
- Support: prepare affected-customer list and distribution plan (by COB)
- Legal: review detailed RCA and approve distribution (by next business day)
Sam: Good. Keep language neutral (avoid vendor blame). We'll send full RCAs after legal sign-off. :thumbsup:
